learning.goal: Recognise the letter B, say its sound 'buh', and name two B words: ball and bear.
learning.shown_how: Shot 1 a big blue foam capital B beside his face; shot 2 one red ball; shot 3 one brown teddy bear; shot 4 B, ball and bear in a row on the mat; shot 5 the B again (loop). The B is the only letter in every frame.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:21 'What starts with B? Hmm?' + 0:21-0:23 humming pause (question boing) -> 0:23 'Ball! Bear! B! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: say 'buh, buh, buh', bounce with me, wave to the bear
learning.fact_check: Capital B checked the correct way round in every frame; one ball, one bear (shot 2 has a C1 second ball at 3-6.5 s – not used).
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, calm bright playroom, one baby, big face.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: letter B pops up

title: Wow! A Big Letter B! 🔵 B Is for Ball & Bear | Learn ABC with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A big blue letter B pops up right next to Baby Jimmy! 🔵 Sing along with Baby Jimmy and learn the letter B, its sound "buh" and two B words: ball and bear.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A big letter B!"
🔤 B, B, B! Buh, buh, buh!
🔴 B is for ball! Bounce, bounce, bounce!
🧸 B is for bear! Wave to the bear!
🤔 "What starts with B?" – can you answer?
👋 B says buh, buh, buh! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: the letter B • the B sound "buh" • ball • bear • first words for toddlers

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along ABC song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Jimmy in the Crayon Babies playroom learning the letter B with a bouncy red ball and a soft teddy bear.
